title: ForgeWire Fabric Settings v1
description: Hub-wide settings layered between immutable defaults and repo/task policy. Tier-1 control-plane values remain in rqlite; an external history database is optional and never in the failover path.

key_provider.description: Master-key provider. Secret values themselves are never settings values.

key_file.description: Path to an ACL-restricted master-key file. Redacted from list/export output.

mode.description: Derived history mode. Thin mode is fully functional and has no external database dependency.

dsn.description: Operator-supplied PostgreSQL-compatible DSN. Discovery never supplies credentials or connects automatically.

autodetect.description: Observational port discovery only; never authorizes a database connection.

provision.description: Request a separately supervised, optional Fabric-managed Tier-2 sink.

auth.description: 114C self-service authentication settings. Only fields an implemented code path actually reads belong here -- see crates/fabric-hub/src/routes/authn.rs.

local_only.description: Require POST /auth/bootstrap to originate from a loopback source address. Disabling this is an explicit, documented risk acceptance -- prefer the alternative one-time bootstrap secret file instead of disabling it.

step_up_freshness_minutes.description: 114C.6 administrative step-up freshness window. Capped at 10 -- policy may shorten but not silently lengthen a security limit beyond the reviewed maximum.

passkeys.description: 114C.6. Off by default (enabled=false) until an operator explicitly configures rp_id/allowed_origins -- a fresh capability defaults closed, not open. `HubState.webauthn` is None (not a startup failure) whenever this is disabled or misconfigured; passkey routes then fail closed with AccountPolicyViolation, the rest of the hub stays healthy.

rp_id.description: WebAuthn relying-party ID -- must be a registrable domain (e.g. "localhost" or "fabric.example"), never an IP literal ("127.0.0.1" is rejected even when an allowed_origins entry uses that literal as its host -- use rp_id "localhost" for loopback deployments instead). Null means passkeys cannot be built regardless of `enabled`.

items.description: Must be `https://...`, or exactly `http://localhost` / `http://127.0.0.1` (the WebAuthn secure-context loopback carve-out). Any other plain-HTTP origin (e.g. a LAN address) is rejected at config-load time, not left to fail confusingly mid-ceremony -- 114C.6 is scoped to loopback/HTTPS deployments only.
